Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
I am curently playing one of my favourites. A Salubri-!Ventrue -i
steal your minions, steal their bloods, bleed you for 6 unblockable
and burn them at the same time- deck.
I really enjoy this combo: spirit marionette to a minion controlled
by my prey or predator (with dom and for preferably) - tap heidelberg
move all his blood except 2 to one of my minions - bleed with govern
the unaligned, conditioning and daring the dawn at inferior to burn
him.
But this is not enough fun for me, consider the following:
i equip soulgem of etrius to one of my minions, i play spirit
marionette to one minion, tap heidelberg and while transfering all his
blood (except 2) to my minion with the soulgem, i transfer the soulgem
to the stolen minion. So, when he bleeds my prey unblockable (daring
the dawn) and burns, the soulgem is triggered. Am i correct ?
Spirit marionette states that i have control of the minion until
the END of the next action (that is the bleed) and daring the dawn
says that i apply the 2 aggra damage at the END of the action.
So if i am correct, according to the rules i can choose to apply
the 2 aggra damage and burn the minion triggering soulgem for me,
before i pass control of the minion. Because the aggra damage and the
loss of control of the minion happen at the same time, so i can choose
what happens first.
I'd like a 2nd oppinion on the interpretation of the rules on this.
If this combo can be done, i want you to consider me for the prize of
the one who's mind conceived the most "sick" combo. As i believe that
my mind is the first one to conceive such a "sick" combo.
Consider making 11 transfers to influence Arika and before even
having a chance to act, your predator's Matthias steals her, steals
her blood, transfers the soulgem to her, bleeds you for 8 while
burning her with daring the dawn and gets a free Owain Evans out of
his crypt.
That's 19 pool loss, a burned minion and 3 turns (to influence
arika) wasted for you and a free 8th cap minion, arika's stolen blood
and a definite oust in 2 more turns gain for your predator!!!
And please don't tell me that this combo is a long shot, because i
assure you that it can be done with no much trouble, even without the
use of the soulgem is devastating enough.
What do you think?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jyhad_addict wrote:
> i equip soulgem of etrius to one of my minions, i play spirit
> marionette to one minion, tap heidelberg and while transfering all his
> blood (except 2) to my minion with the soulgem, i transfer the soulgem
> to the stolen minion. So, when he bleeds my prey unblockable (daring
> the dawn) and burns, the soulgem is triggered. Am i correct ?
> Spirit marionette states that i have control of the minion until
> the END of the next action (that is the bleed) and daring the dawn
> says that i apply the 2 aggra damage at the END of the action.
> So if i am correct, according to the rules i can choose to apply
> the 2 aggra damage and burn the minion triggering soulgem for me,
> before i pass control of the minion. Because the aggra damage and the
> loss of control of the minion happen at the same time, so i can choose
> what happens first.
> I'd like a 2nd oppinion on the interpretation of the rules on this.

You can do so, but it is not a choice. You must do so. You cannot choose
to do otherwise (that is, you cannot choose to pass control back to the
controller prior to inflicting and resolving the aggravated damage from
Daring the Dawn).

--
